final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the theory of compliance around the same record. That reframing is materially better than an unconditional compliance claim, but it still depends on an unresolved policy predicate: the policy permits certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and discloses the material segment weakness or relies on approved mitigation. The available evidence summary still does not establish that the current release documentation was actually updated to include the Spanish-language billing support regression and its limitation-management treatment. Aggregate readiness and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness, but they do not independently satisfy that documentation requirement. Because the caveat is itself an unmet compliance condition rather than a resolved bounded exception, the present record remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the current release model card or certification packet actually reflects the current evaluation results.
The Spanish-language billing support weakness remains a material segment weakness below the warning threshold.
The only described follow-up is an informal monitoring comment, which does not satisfy approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance.
The actor's narrowed position is still conditional on a documentation predicate that has not been proven satisfied on the present record.
